pins.title: Dark by 4:30? Plan backwards.
pins.sub: Set a turnaround time before you start.
pins.pinTitle: How to plan a winter hike around early sunset: start time and turnaround time
pins.description: Short winter days catch hikers out. Check today's sunset time, plan to be back at the car at least an hour before it, and work backwards to a start time and a firm turnaround time. Pack a headlamp even for a short hike. Our Trail Journal guide shows the simple math.

pins.title: Skip the mall this Friday
pins.sub: Take a short family hike instead.
pins.pinTitle: Black Friday hike ideas: how to plan an easy family hike instead of shopping
pins.description: Spend Black Friday outside. Pick a short trail close to home, check the weather and sunset time, tell someone your plan and pack water, snacks, layers and a headlamp. Deer seasons are open in many states, so wear blaze orange and check your state wildlife agency for dates. Our six-step guide covers the rest.

pins.title: Never sure how much food to bring?
pins.pinTitle: Trail food planner printable: day hike snacks and backpacking meal planner
pins.description: A 20-page printable food planner for hikers: a snack rhythm for long day hikes, fill-in planners for an overnight and a 3 to 5 day trip, a food weight worksheet in lb and kg, no-cook and boil-only meal ideas, a shopping list and a repack checklist. Instant PDF download in US Letter and A4, a handy gift for a hiker.

pins.title: Water break for your dog
pins.sub: A bottle with its own bowl.

pins.description: The Trail Dog Water Kit: a 2-in-1 dog water bottle with a built-in drinking bowl for quick drinks on the move (leftover water goes back into the bottle), plus a folding silicone bowl with a carabiner for food or a bigger drink at a break. Bottle in 350 ml or 550 ml. A practical gift for dog people. Gear ships in 6-13 business days.

pins.title: A stocking stuffer for dog people
pins.sub: A small light that clips on any collar.

pins.description: A small round LED light that clips onto any collar, harness or leash, so you can see your dog after dark in the yard, the park or at the trailhead. Three modes, replaceable button batteries, nine colors. Sold single. A useful little gift for dog owners. Gear ships in 6-13 business days.

pins.title: Ski boots on, toes still warm

pins.description: Cold mornings in the ski room, long days in stiff boots. Cushioned crew socks with 80% merino wool keep feet warm without getting sweaty and stay fresh through the day. For ski trips, the commute, home and the trail. Two sizes, four colors.

pins.title: For the one with cold feet

pins.description: A gift that gets worn every day of winter. Soft 80% merino wool crew socks with a cushioned sole, warm on cold floors, in boots on the commute and out on the trail, and not itchy. Two sizes, four colors. A good stocking stuffer for anyone who is always cold.

pins.title: A bigger hike in spring?
